def VTask.strongDownwardInduction {α : Type u_1} {p : Multiset α → Sort u_3} {n : ℕ} 
    (H : (t₁ : Multiset α) → ({t₂ : Multiset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁) 
    (s : Multiset α) (hs : s.card ≤ n) : p s :=
  match hs with
  | Nat.zero =>
    let h : ∀ t₂ : Multiset α, t₂.card ≤ 0 → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂ :=
      fun _ _ _ => sorry -- Vacuously true because there are no elements in the multiset
    H ∅ h 0
  | Nat.succ k =>
    let ih : ∀ t₂ : Multiset α, t₂.card ≤ k → t₁ < t₂ → p t₂ := fun t₂ hk ht => 
      VTask.strongDownwardInduction H t₂ hk
    H s ih k
